name: Closter Plaza
summary: Closter Plaza is a historic 1960s shopping center in Bergen County, marked by its iconic 'dancing diamond' marquee and thoughtfully restored by EDENS in 2012. As the only retail destination within a five-mile radius, it serves the Closter community with premium retailers like J.Crew, Warby Parker, and Bluemercury alongside diverse dining and entertainment options.
demographics: Closter Plaza serves an affluent Bergen County community with high household incomes and educated professionals. The primary trade area consists of families and established residents in their 30s-60s who value quality shopping and dining experiences close to home. The center attracts discerning shoppers seeking premium brands like J.Crew, Warby Parker, and Bluemercury, reflecting the area's upscale demographic profile and preference for convenience combined with quality retail offerings.
description: Closter Plaza stands as a beloved shopping and dining destination in Closter, New Jersey, distinguished by its iconic illuminated 'dancing diamond' marquee that has become a landmark in Bergen County. Originally built in the 1960s, this historic shopping center was thoughtfully acquired and restored by EDENS in 2012, preserving its nostalgic charm while modernizing it for today's shoppers. As the only retail destination within a five-mile stretch of Bergen County, Closter Plaza serves as an essential community gathering place, offering residents convenient access to an impressive array of shopping, dining, health and wellness, and entertainment options. The center has successfully attracted premium retailers including J.Crew, Warby Parker, and Bluemercury, demonstrating its appeal to quality-conscious shoppers. Located at 19 VerValen Street, Closter Plaza represents a unique blend of historical preservation and contemporary retail excellence, where yesterday and today are seamlessly connected through community engagement and thoughtful curation of tenant mix.
